description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools, TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, on two categories of tweets: Emoji Tweets and Overall Tweets. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy", with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in intervals of 0.2. For each category, three bars are grouped together, representing the accuracy of TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, colored in white with diagonal lines, gray with diagonal lines, and green, respectively. In the Emoji Tweets category, the bars have approximate values of 0.33 for TEXTBLOB, 0.48 for VADER, and 0.65 for ChatGPT. In the Overall Tweets category, the bars have approximate values of 0.38 for TEXTBLOB, 0.45 for VADER, and 0.63 for ChatGPT. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative accuracy of the three sentiment analysis tools across the two tweet categories.
